title: Neon Prospector
subtitle: Time the swing. Take the gold.
description: Descend through 60 sectors with five contract types, drifting ore, volatile mines and armored vaults. Upgrade the winch, freeze the field and chain hauls before the deep-sector timer expires.
controls: Tap the mine or Space to cast. X discards cargo, E boosts the winch, T adds time, F freezes ore, Q toggles scanning. All controls and the Item Store are embedded in the mine.
headline: The undercity.|Yours to mine.
heroDescription: Descend through 60 sectors with five contract types, drifting ore, volatile mines and armored vaults. Upgrade the winch, freeze the field and chain hauls before the deep-sector timer expires.
caption: NEON PROSPECTOR · DEEP CITY MINING

title: Prism Breaker
subtitle: Bend light. Rewrite the angle.
description: Break crystals to charge directional Refraction, then bend every ball up-left or up-right at the critical moment. A 24-sector campaign with capsules, chain explosions and permanent perk drafts.
controls: Q / E or in-scene arrow abilities bend light for 4 charge. Mouse, A/D or touch drag steers; Space pulses. F toggles a faint direction hint.
headline: Bend light.|Rewrite the angle.
heroDescription: Break crystals to charge directional Refraction, then bend every ball up-left or up-right at the critical moment. A 24-sector campaign with capsules, chain explosions and permanent perk drafts.
caption: PRISM BREAKER · CRYSTAL CAMPAIGN

title: Neon Coil
subtitle: Grow a circuit. Close it. Cash it in.
description: Grow to at least 9 segments, loop back into your own circuit around empty tiles, then discharge the enclosed area for points and a shorter tail. Bigger circuits reward deliberate routing; small knots still end the run.
controls: WASD, arrows, swipe or in-scene D-pad. Gold segments are connection points: close a loop around at least one empty tile.
headline: Grow a circuit.|Close it. Cash it in.
heroDescription: Grow to at least 9 segments, loop back into your own circuit around empty tiles, then discharge the enclosed area for points and a shorter tail. Bigger circuits reward deliberate routing; small knots still end the run.
caption: NEON COIL · LIVING CIRCUIT

title: Starfall
subtitle: Catch their fire. Send it home.
description: Trade your guns for a temporary capture shield. Absorb up to six enemy shots, then release a reflected fan for double points per hit. Overheating leaves a two-second opening: read the enemy volley and choose your moment.
controls: Mouse, A/D, arrows or drag to steer. Hold W or CAPTURE to absorb; release to reflect. Space / FIRE for manual shots, or enable Auto fire.
headline: Catch their fire.|Send it home.
heroDescription: Trade your guns for a temporary capture shield. Absorb up to six enemy shots, then release a reflected fan for double points per hit. Overheating leaves a two-second opening: read the enemy volley and choose your moment.
caption: STARFALL · ORBITAL DEFENCE

title: Drift Run
subtitle: Leave an echo. Steal a second line.
description: A lane change leaves an echo that catches rings behind you. Echo pickups and close passes charge a brief Overdrive that smashes barriers. Plan two lanes at once as the city accelerates.
controls: A/D, arrows, swipes or in-scene arrows change lanes. Space or OVERDRIVE spends three earned charges on a burst.
headline: Leave an echo.|Steal a second line.
heroDescription: A lane change leaves an echo that catches rings behind you. Echo pickups and close passes charge a brief Overdrive that smashes barriers. Plan two lanes at once as the city accelerates.
caption: DRIFT RUN · AFTER HOURS

title: OpenStrike
subtitle: One arena. One clean shot.
description: A sunlit harbor, charming robots and a clean first-person duel. Train at three difficulty levels or invite a friend. Original OpenStrike rules with native Myelin replay verification.
controls: Choose Rookie, Standard or Veteran training, or invite a friend for a 90-second duel. WASD moves, mouse aims, click fires, Shift walks and R reloads. Escape opens the in-game menu. Touch controls, field of view and sensitivity are adjustable in Your setup.
headline: One arena.|One clean shot.
heroDescription: Find your angle in Neon Divide. A quick first-person duel, with every round ready to replay.
caption: OPENSTRIKE · NEON DIVIDE

title: Teeworlds
subtitle: Hook in. Let it fly.
description: A fast little arena with double jumps, grappling hooks, and a friend to outplay. The classic fixed-point engine, now with Myelin match replays.
controls: A/D to move, Space to double jump, mouse to aim, left click to fire, right click to hook. Create a private duel or practice against a bot.
headline: Hook in.|Let it fly.
heroDescription: Little feet. Long reach. Grab a friend for a minute of movement and mayhem.
caption: TEEWORLDS · GRASSLAND ARENA

title: Skyward
subtitle: A little pull. A big adventure.
description: Meet Pip. Pull back and free the garden spirits across twelve islands in four richly illustrated worlds. Equip bloom bombs and star feathers, earn supply-shop coins, and perfect each flight with slow-motion replay.
controls: Drag Pip back from the slingshot and release. You can also use the angle and power sliders.
headline: A little pull.|A big adventure.
heroDescription: Four beautiful garden worlds. A satchel of possibilities. Find your perfect arc.
caption: SKYWARD · THE FLOATING GARDENS

title: The Quiet Board
subtitle: Make your next move.
description: A sunlit chess retreat. Play a friend or three computer levels with porcelain pieces, drag-and-drop moves, a SAN journal and verified replays.
controls: Tap or drag pieces. Play a friend locally or choose one of three computer levels in the in-game menu.
headline: Your next|brilliant move.
heroDescription: A sunlit conservatory. Ivory and jade pieces. Three training partners, or a friend across the board.
caption: THE QUIET BOARD · CONSERVATORY
